caption: The video captures a wide seascape bathed in the warm orange-gold light of a low sun resting just above a flat horizon. The bright disc of the sun hangs nearly motionless, its position against the sky and the silhouetted rocky island on the right staying constant throughout the excerpt. Beneath it, a vertical column of golden reflection stretches across the water toward the foreground, where gentle ripples continually shift and reform. Individual specular glints flicker along this shimmering path, brightening and fading as the surface undulates. A fainter low landmass traces the far left horizon, and a few thin clouds hang in the upper sky. The camera holds its framing steady. The visible motion thus resides in the restless sea surface rather than in any descent of the sun.
